description: You are a satellite operations engineer monitoring the INST satellite's thermal subsystem. The Limits Monitor tool is open in OpenC3 COSMOS showing real-time limit violations. The satellite's TEMP1 sensor on the HEALTH_STATUS packet is fluctuating and may trigger a thermal alarm (yellow or red limit violation). Your task: (1) Open the Limits Monitor tool from the navigation menu if not already visible, (2) Observe the telemetry for any limit violations on temperature items (TEMP1, TEMP2, TEMP3, TEMP4), (3) When you see a temperature limit violation (yellow warning or red critical), navigate to the Command Sender tool using the left sidebar, (4) Select target 'INST' and command 'CLEAR' from the dropdown menus, (5) Click 'Send' to execute the command -- note: CLEAR is a hazardous command so a confirmation dialog will appear, click 'Send' again to confirm. The password for OpenC3 is Cosmos2024! if you are prompted to log in.
